oil_prod_kbd.label: Oil production
oil_prod_kbd.desc: Crude oil, condensate and natural gas liquids.

oil_cons_kbd.label: Oil consumption
oil_cons_kbd.desc: Inland demand plus bunkers and refinery fuel; excludes biofuels.

net_oil_kbd.label: Net oil balance
net_oil_kbd.desc: Production minus consumption. Positive = net exporter.

oil_import_dep.label: Oil import dependence
oil_import_dep.desc: Share of oil consumption not covered by domestic production.

net_gas_bcm.label: Net gas balance
net_gas_bcm.desc: Production minus consumption. Positive = net exporter.

gas_import_dep.label: Gas import dependence
gas_import_dep.desc: Share of gas consumption not covered by domestic production.

coal_prod_mt.label: Coal production
coal_prod_mt.desc: Hard coal and lignite, in physical tonnes.

tes_ej.label: Total energy supply
tes_ej.desc: All commercially traded fuels and modern renewables.

low_carbon_share_elec.label: Low-carbon electricity
low_carbon_share_elec.desc: Nuclear plus renewables, share of generation.

hormuz_oil_share.label: Oil imports via Hormuz
hormuz_oil_share.desc: Share of 2025 crude and product imports shipped through the Strait of Hormuz (routed customs data).

hormuz_lng_share.label: LNG imports via Hormuz
hormuz_lng_share.desc: Share of 2025 LNG imports shipped through the Strait of Hormuz (Qatar and UAE cargoes).

sources.label: UN Comtrade — rare earth metals and compounds (HS 280530, 284610, 284690)
sources.vintage: 2025, with 2024 fallback; importer reports plus partner-reported exports

sources.label: Energy Institute — Statistical Review of World Energy 2026
Ember — Yearly electricity data (via Our World in Data)
